fieldValues.title: Harden sibling-resolution against stale branches (srs-rust#874 class), instance #2
fieldValues.summary: srs-rust#874 hardened rfc_035_parity.rs's sibling-checkout resolution against a stale, non-master srs sibling (PR #879); the same unhardened pattern survived in two more places, discovery_conformance.rs and core_bundle_drift.rs (srs-rust#922). Both now prefer SRS_SPEC_DIR and panic loudly naming the branch when the walk-up/fixed-relative sibling fallback finds one that isn't on master.
fieldValues.body: Dispatched from the srs-rust gate:pool queue via srs#580 tick 2026-09-06. Fix in srs-rust PR #964: SRS_SPEC_DIR-first resolution + loud panic on a non-master sibling, matching rfc_035_parity.rs::spec_repo() (PR #879) exactly. Proved by reproducing the false-green live: this session's own srs sibling sits on a non-master branch and was silently trusted by both tests pre-fix; post-fix both panic naming the branch, and both pass green against a fresh origin/master clone via SRS_SPEC_DIR. Grepped tests/ for the same shape; found one more site (integration_tests.rs's srs_spec_repo_dir() Legacy fallback) but left it alone since it is fully shadowed by a higher-priority vendored-fixture check and is dead code today.
